chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives all things?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to affirm the doctrine of *al-Husna* (divine beauty/goodness), asserting that Allah’s essence and actions are purely good, distinct from human limited perception. This aligns with the Shia theological emphasis on God’s absolute wisdom (*Hikmah*) and benevolence (*Lutf*), countering anthropomorphic or dualistic views by positing that all divine decrees, whether perceived as joy or trial, originate from a source of pure goodness.
